})()

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
(function(){
  try {
    var data = result;
    if (typeof data === 'string') data = JSON.parse(data);
    if (!data || data.code != 1 || !data.data) return [];

    var bookUrl = book.bookUrl || '';
    var hm = bookUrl.match(/[?&]host=([^&]+)/);
    var bm = bookUrl.match(/[?&]hid=([^&]+)/);
    var host = hm ? hm[1] : '';
    var bookid = bm ? bm[1] : '';
    java.put('stv_host', host);
    java.put('stv_bookid', bookid);

    var rawStr = (data.data || '').trim();
    if (!rawStr) return [];
    var chapters = rawStr.split('-//-');

    var titleSource = null;
    if (data.oridata && data.oridata.trim().length > 0) {
      titleSource = data.oridata.trim().split('-//-');
    } else if (data.enckey) {
      try {
        titleSource = java.base64Decode(data.enckey).split('-//-');
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    var list = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < chapters.length; i++) {
      var parts = chapters[i].split('-/-');
      if (parts.length < 3) continue;

      var cid = parts[1];
      var title = parts[2];

      if (titleSource && i < titleSource.length) {
        var tsParts = titleSource[i].split('-/-');
        if (tsParts.length >= 3 && tsParts[2].length > 0) {
          title = tsParts[2];
        }
      }

      var url = '/index.php?sajax=readchapter&h=' + host + '&bookid=' + bookid + '&c=' + cid;
      list.push({
        chapterUrl: url,
        chapterName: title
      });
    }

    return list;
  } catch(e) { return []; }
})()
</js>
